script:
control-agent-server fixture llm-stub --name qa-f05-resume --step 'tool:finish:{"message":"QA_F05_RESUMED"}'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$R/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.run-after-interrupt/run
